name: Squirrels and Grapevine
dimensions:
painting proper: 148.6 x 47.5 cm (58 1/2 x 18 11/16 in.)
mounting, with suspension cord and roller ends: 210.2 x 70.5 cm (82 3/4 x 27 3/4 in.)
summary: Painted in ink on paper, this hanging scroll represents an upside-down, U-shaped, old grapevine with two squirrels sporting amongst the fruiting branches. The grapevine comprises four intertwined, leafy stalks that enter the composition in the lower left corner, diagonally traverse the composition, rise along the right edge, make a U-turn at the top, and then extend down the left edge.
